profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Garmin | Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from RIT
profile.summary: Hello! I am a fulltime Software Engineer at Raytheon Missiles & Defense and am currently an individual contributor for a Software Integration and Test team (SWIT). I graduated from Rochester Institute of Technology in 2023 with a degree in Electrical Engineering and a focus on Computer Engineering. My current goal is find a home on an Embedded Software team, where my unique set of professional experiences will operate at their highest potential. Between college, internships, and my full time role, I have acquired a breadth of experiences developing software for embedded systems, developing graphical user interfaces, CPU architecture and design, and the development of automated tests for both software and hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Manages software and investigates issues for multiple Linux based software strings.
- Owner of two software capabilities, working with development teams to verify bug fixes and features, and implement automated verification/regression tests using Squish tooling, Python, Shell, and Jenkins.
- Transitioned automated test tooling from Subversion to Git/Bitbucket.
positions.insights: Software Testing, Software Integration and +10 skills

positions.title: Physical Design Coop
positions.description:
- Developed a parameterized implementation for place and route of flip-flop submodules within a physical register file module using Tcl/Tk scripts and System Verilog. 
- Owned the area, timing, and design rule check analysis for utilization of flip-flops as submodules within a physical register file utilizing the Synopsys toolset.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Ran and graded weekly labs for 20+ students.
- Taught students methods for implementing various peripherals on a 16-bit MSP430 microcontroller.
- Implemented a discord, for use in conjunction with the main lab period, where students could reach out at any time and ask questions.
positions.insights: Bare Metal Embedded, Interpersonal Skills and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
- Developed the embedded software for a CLI-based stepper motor test station using STM32-HAL drivers and C, as well as implemented the electrical setup for the test station.
-  Reworked the design and implementation of an acoustic analysis GUI within an existing data acquisition C# WPF application that displayed spectrogram, frequency, and voltage information from seismic sensors and microphone arrays.
- Developed and wrote tests scripts for automated formal quality testing of multiple embedded systems, and implemented the test station hardware setup.

projects.title: Password Manager
projects.description:
- Developed a password manager using C# and the WPF GUI framework. 
- Wrote a custom encryption and decryption toolset that is based on the principles from AES. 
- Integrated software libraries that accomplished the following: Two Factor Authentication, Password Strength, and JSON parsing. 
- Wrote micro-regression test cases that cover edge cases found during development and tracked them through Google Drive. 
- Version control of this software is on git: https://github.com/branmuffin21/PSManager

projects.title: AGV Charging System
projects.description:
- Designed and built an Autonomous Guidance Vehicle (AGV) as a part of a senior design team.
- Developed the systems design for the AGV’s internal electronics, as well as the power system for the charging station. 
- Designed a PCB board stack that interfaced a Raspberry Pi with numerous I2C and SPI based microdevices, as well as other microcontrollers. 
- Co-designed the TCP/IP communication interface and packet format between the AGV and the charging station. 
- Designed and built a relay power switching system for swapping between internal power and external power when the AGV is docked to the charging station.
